name: Safe Changes – Change Monitor
author: prespromo

sections.description:
Every time you activate a plugin, update WordPress, or change a theme, your site is at risk.

Safe Changes helps you track important changes in your WordPress site so you can easily identify what happened before an error or unexpected behavior.

This plugin does NOT modify your site or apply fixes.
It focuses on visibility and awareness, keeping your site stable and safe.

Key Features

  • Logs plugin activations and deactivations
  • Logs theme changes
  • Logs WordPress, plugin, and theme updates
  • Stores a clear history in the admin panel
  • Lightweight and safe — no filesystem modifications
  • No configuration required

Need more protection?

Safe Changes PRO adds additional features such as:
* Recovery Mode
* Safe admin access when a plugin breaks the site
* Plugin deactivation without FTP

Learn more:
https://seniorweb.es/plugins/
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install it through the Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to Tools → Safe Changes to view the logs.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin fix broken sites?

No. This plugin only logs changes. Recovery features are available in the PRO version.

Is this plugin safe to use on production sites?

Yes. It does not modify files or affect performance.

Does it send data externally?

No. All data is stored locally in your WordPress database.
